title: Memory
subtitle: Stores durable preferences, project facts, instructions, and decisions locally in IndexedDB. Retrieved memories may be sent to the current model as context.
serverSubtitle: Durable preferences, project facts, instructions, and decisions are stored by the server and retrieved only when relevant.
searchToggleDesc: Allow the model to call a local memory search tool when past context may matter.
recordToggleDesc: Use a background AI task to save only important long-term information.
dreamToggleDesc: When active memories exceed 100, consolidate them into 50 or fewer entries.
privacyNote: Memories stay in this browser by default. Search results are included in the current model request when the memory tool is used.
serverPrivacyNote: Memories are stored on the server. Only a small relevant set is sent to the current model as lower-priority context.
contentPlaceholder: Write a durable preference, instruction, project fact, warning, decision, or context note…
governanceSubtitle: Manage Global, Project, and Conversation memories with provenance, revisions, answer usage, reviews, and deletion progress. The v1 Global reader remains the answer authority.
staleOrFailed: State may have changed and the operation did not complete. Your input was preserved; refresh and retry.
masterToggleDesc: Stops server memory Use and Learn when disabled.
globalUseDesc: Allow current memories to be retrieved before an answer.
globalLearnDesc: Allow background tasks to propose memories after an answer.
sensitiveMemoryDesc: Allow sensitive facts to be stored and used when relevant. Credentials and secrets remain permanently rejected.
noConversations: No conversations are available to govern.
archiveLearnOff: Project archived; Learn is forced off
targetChanged: The target changed. Refresh before deciding.
backupExpires: Supported plaintext backups expire no later than {date}.
diagnosticsPrivacy: Shows only profile, status, counts, tokens, and duration—never query, content, embeddings, or raw scores.
noUsage: Not used by an answer yet.
activitySummary: Memory activity: {created} created · {corrected} corrected · {review} review · {failed} failed
undoFailed: Undo failed. Refresh and try again.
